A pipeline can tolerate mediocre quality or weak verification on a low-stakes record, but it cannot tolerate under-protecting a high-criticality one, and conversely it would be wasteful to over-invest expensive on-chain verification machinery on a trivial record. This makes C the primary lever that determines how much the other five dimensions even matter for a given record, which is why I rate it Best. That relative fixability is why I place Q as Worst, not because quality is unimportant in absolute terms. Legal Compliance (L) sits close behind Criticality for me -- regulatory mandates on construction records (permits, safety signoffs) often directly encode criticality judgements made by an external authority, so L is a close second; I flagged this as a genuinely close call rather than a clear-cut one.
